note: معرض is both مَعْرِض 'exhibition/fair/display' and مُعَرَّض 'exposed/susceptible', a common adjective/passive-participle reading omitted by the current entry.
proposed_english: exhibition; fair; display; exposed; susceptible (depending on vocalization/use)

note: حي is a major homograph: حَيّ means 'alive/living' while حَيّ also means a neighborhood/district. Omitting the adjective reading is a serious learner gap.
صدر is also the extremely common noun صَدْر 'chest; breast; front/forepart', not only the perfect verb 'was issued/published/came from'.
proposed_english: chest; breast; front; was issued; was published; came from (depending on vocalization/use)
